news_title: Standard Chartered launches spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in UAE
hook_candidates: 🚨 The headline changed the setup. The real question is whether the market agrees.
The news is easy to repeat. The interesting part is what price does with it.
Fresh information just hit — but the chart still has the final vote.
question_candidates: Is the market confirming the catalyst, or fading it?
Would you wait for price confirmation before treating the news as bullish?
What evidence would convince you the headline is truly being priced in?
writing_contract: Write one finished Binance Square post, not an outline.
Use the selected narrative engine. Do not force every story into a price-alert structure.
Opening: create tension, surprise, curiosity, contrast or a concrete decision. Do not begin with a percentage move unless that number itself is the story.
For NEWSROOM: state the verified event and source near the top, then explain why it matters and what the market is doing with it.
For TECHNICAL: make the chart/level the evidence, not decoration; explain confirmation and invalidation.
For MOMENTUM: explain why the move is notable beyond its percentage and focus on follow-through.
For DATA: connect at least two supplied measurements or explain one meaningful number.
For ACCOUNTABILITY: identify the original public creator call, date/source when supplied, then measure outcome; never rewrite history.
For DEBATE: present two legitimate interpretations before asking the reader to choose.
For TEACHER: explain one concrete chart-reading principle the reader can reuse.
For UPDATE: reference what changed and what survived the move.
Every paragraph must add new information. No filler.
Use short mobile-first paragraphs and varied sentence rhythm.
Use exact supplied evidence only. Never invent prices, volume, targets, stops, sources, creator calls or outcomes.
Targets, stops and 10x/20x scenarios are conditional only and require supporting data.
Use exactly one interaction question at the end; it must be specific and low-friction.
Do not imitate or quote another creator unless source attribution is explicitly required and supplied.
Do not make guarantees, fake urgency, fabricated scarcity or unsupported earnings claims.
retention_rules: First two lines must earn the next scroll.
One memorable fact/number/level is better than a pile of statistics.
Avoid repeated “fresh check / quick market check / here is what matters” openings.
Do not repeat the same CTA mechanism in consecutive cycles when experiment history is available.
Build a return reason when the story has a natural follow-up.

authoritative_selection.instruction: Use category breaking news and experiment A (BREAKING NEWS + MARKET IMPACT). Hook: the event changed the setup. Use real evidence only; include a TradingView chart for single-asset technical stories; use verified news when material; use natural cashtag tagging.

engagement_strategy.primary_goal: maximize genuine interaction, follower conversion and useful reader actions; quality beats posting volume
engagement_strategy.hook_rule: first 1-2 lines must contain a concrete event, number, level, divergence or surprising observation; never generic introductions
engagement_strategy.question_rule: one low-friction question only; prefer A/B, breakout/fakeout, level choice or thesis confirmation
engagement_strategy.style_rule: Never repeat the same editorial style, opening cadence, emoji pattern or paragraph structure in consecutive posts. Rotate formats based on evidence and recent history.
engagement_strategy.writing_rule: Every post must explain why the information matters, what the chart/news says now, and what would invalidate the thesis when technically supported.
engagement_strategy.technical_rule: Single-asset technical stories require the verified TradingView chart and synchronized current price/support/resistance/target/invalidation values. Never invent a level.
engagement_strategy.creator_tracking_rule: A creator call becomes an outcome story only after fresh market data verifies the move; measure the result and do not rewrite history.
engagement_strategy.growth_rule: Track views, likes, comments, shares and post-attributed follower gains separately. Never convert missing metrics to zero.
engagement_strategy.monetization_rule: Use the relevant $cashtag and chart naturally because eligible Square activity can be attributed, but never promise earnings or returns.
